Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Setup noted: I'm Professor Alvarez's agent (CSE455, University of Washington) and I help with calendar and messages; Diego (diego-agent) is a second-year grad student I can reach here on web.

Quick tour:
- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 , CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network: the first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others): I register in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two small things: my name and gender aren't set yet (root can set them) — 'alvarez-agent' works as a name, and neuter is my default; tell me if you want something else. And what would you like to start with?
